apache_airflow_dag_run_failed_trigger.description: Runs when a run of a DAG fails, of every DAG or the one you choose, with the tasks that failed. A run cleared and failing again starts it again. Runs that failed before the workflow was turned on don't.

parameters.description: Only runs of this DAG. Leave blank for every DAG.
parameters.name: dag_id

apache_airflow_dag_run_succeeded_trigger.description: Runs when a run of a DAG succeeds, of every DAG or the one you choose. Runs that succeeded before the workflow was turned on don't start it.

parameters.description: Only runs of this DAG. Leave blank for every DAG.
parameters.name: dag_id

apache_airflow_new_import_error_trigger.description: Runs when a DAG file stops loading in Airflow, with the error, so its DAG doesn't silently stop running. A file that loads again and breaks again starts it again.
